order: This pass runs the exercise round for the review roster. Every outcome gets recorded in full rather than summarized, starting with the Conductor's session, which gets audited against the role's guardrails and given a ruled disposition for the one violation found, the audit itself standing as a complete written record that must never shrink into a shorter one. The P0 substrate is live-exercised end to end, and the run produces its own written report rather than borrowed language. The Architect role gets attempted too, even though the environment blocks it, and the blocked attempt is preserved as its own transcript. A second attempt keeps a second transcript of its own instead of overwriting the first, so both remain on record. The band record and status summary then get updated to the real per-seat outcomes, confined to what was actually exercised, and the substrate's own production behavior stays untouched throughout.
claims: The Conductor's transcript was audited fully against the guardrails. A disposition was ruled for the single violation it turned up, recorded as a complete written audit rather than a brief summary of it. The P0 substrate was live-exercised end to end, and its outcome was checked into its own written report. The Architect exercise was attempted twice, but the environment blocked both attempts, so both transcripts were kept on record, and the test suite gained only the changes the runs actually required.
